title: Qualitative rubric fail: non-gating contract string absent from role file opening
description: retrospective-reviewer.role.md opens with 'You are a Retrospective Reviewer.' rather than the exact required non-gating contract: 'You are the Retrospective Reviewer. You NEVER gate a run. All signals you emit must be Major or Minor severity. Critical is forbidden in this phase.' The qualitative rubric criterion explicitly requires this exact opening string. Semantic non-gating content is present in the Values section but the prescribed opening sentence is absent.
proposed_resolution: Replace the opening of src/moeb/internal/roles/retrospective-reviewer.role.md with the exact non-gating contract string specified in Step 1 of spec moeb.qa-architect-mandatory-checks-cover-correctness-on.
